name: Upper / lower split
notes: This plan divides your body into top and bottom halves. Train upper on some days and lower on others so you can do more volume. Weights are starting placeholders — use what you can finish with 1–2 reps in reserve.

activities.name: Upper body
activities.instructions: Chest press, rows, and shoulder press. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Chest press
exercises.instructions: Lower with control, then press without locking the elbows hard.
exercises.notes: Dumbbell floor press is fine if you train at home.

exercises.name: Bent-over row
exercises.instructions: Hinge, keep the torso still, and pull the elbows toward the hips.

exercises.name: Shoulder press
exercises.instructions: Brace, press up, and do not over-arch the lower back.

activities.name: Lower body
activities.instructions: Squats, leg extensions, and calves. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Squat
exercises.instructions: Sit between the hips, keep the chest up, then stand tall.
exercises.notes: Goblet squat if you train with dumbbells.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.instructions: Extend the knees without snapping them straight. Lower slowly.
exercises.notes: Swap for split squats or goblet squats at home.

exercises.name: Calf raise
exercises.instructions: Rise onto the toes, pause, then lower through a full stretch.

activities.name: Upper body
activities.instructions: Pull-downs, curls, and triceps. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to the upper chest. Do not lean too far back.
exercises.notes: One-arm dumbbell rows if you have no cable.

exercises.name: Bicep curl
exercises.instructions: Elbows by the ribs. Lower under control.

exercises.name: Tricep extension
exercises.instructions: Keep the elbows still. Lower, then extend without locking hard.

activities.name: Lower body
activities.instructions: Deadlifts and lunges. Rest about 2 minutes between sets.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Hinge, keep the weight close, and stand tall without shrugging.
exercises.notes: Romanian deadlift with dumbbells is a good home option.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.instructions: Long step, back knee close to the floor, torso tall. Count reps per leg.

exercises.name: Leg curl
exercises.instructions: Curl the heels toward the glutes. Lower slowly.
exercises.notes: Swap for extra Romanian deadlifts at home.
